description: An error of a statement after "-- @migace finally" does not hide the first error. The runner still sends the statements after it.
script:
-- @migace script format=1
-- @migace statement label="a, part p"
select 1 / 0
-- @migace finally
-- @migace statement
select broken()
-- @migace statement
select 3

error.message: a, part p: division by zero
